posts.title: UniBLEed: Unauthenticated Root RCE on Any Unitree G1 Humanoid Robot Within Bluetooth Range
posts.description: Root on a $20,000 humanoid robot from Bluetooth range. One chain crossing Bluetooth, Unitree’s cloud, mobile, and the firmware running the G1 itself. Here’s the complete technical breakdown of the $6,700 bounty and two CVEs it produced: CVE-2026-76639 / CVE-2026-76640.
